lesson_text: A review sweep re-dispatch (`review_autofix_sweep.yml`, which dispatches from the default branch with no `--ref` since #4618) attaches its check runs to the default branch's SHA, not the PR head, so a failed `review / codex-agent` from an earlier outage stays on the head even after a clean re-review. Only a run on the PR head clears it: a new push, or a dispatch with `--ref <head branch>` such as the orchestrator's conflict-recovery dispatch (`_dispatch_review_for_conflicts`).
